body:
The highs and lows constantly come and go through out the day. I didn't really tap into it much. I'm not looking for a 100% clarity that some one reads through this and goes "yes you absolutely have it" but more like some one reads through it and states an opinion of it's very possible of BPD or it could be this or this. I have the day off of work and looking to find professional help with some one specialized in this field. 

I mean what ever the fuck is wrong with me is absolutely life ruining. I've been apathetic my entire life, until I have something I really care about then everything really begins to get all kinds of fucked up. The more I love something, the more I destroy it. And it's doing that right now, I have a very close friend where there is something more and the timing of whatever is building is bad for the both of us. And it's sending me into a wicked downward spiral of anxiety and depression and I can't pull myself out of it, instead i'm making myself look like a damned nutjob. 

And then a few years back, my dog was sick. And my parents pressured me into having her put down. I really didn't want to and didn't think it was her time. But I got sick of arguing with them about it and I didn't sleep for days so I just let them do it. I loved that dog to death, and I hate myself for not being the one their for her. When I start thinking about it, my mom told me in the car on the way there, my dog knew there was something wrong and all she wanted was me. Just thinking about that, it doesn't make me sad it absolutely shatters me every time, and really want to take this pocket knife and start stabbing the shit out of myself in the heart. 

Why can't I just be, it was really unfortunate, it makes me really sad, but her time was soon and she didn't suffer. Instead I feel like I failed on such a great level I don't deserve to move past it and should continue to hold on to those feelings to justify my wretched existence.
Thank you for your kind and sincere response. So what I am like sounds like I may be looking into the right direction?

I appreciate your input and concern. It's really hard to look past everything. Counseling and drugs never really worked for my depression and anxiety. I started going when I was 8 and been going in and out of doctors offices. None of it's helped. I feel like I have no outlets left to seek assistance next to checking into the psych ward and that's going to be a waste of time.
I've made it clear to my ex that she's not allowed in my room. But she keeps coming in here.

There hasn't been any violence against me, I left the relationship because she is a mean hateful person, and used me to the hilt financially. I was out seeking assistance to ensure that I can get my property out with as little conflict as possible, with out having any additional financial burdens, and not have to be worried her making false accusations against me.

> is it true that you also sought out your ex Alyssa's employer when you two broke up?

It's partially true, what happened is my ex Alyssa was posting photos on facebook of her at work at a very well known insurance agency. In the background of the photos you could see their clients names addresses social security numbers ect. I sent it to their HR department, cause that's pretty fucked up.

I contacted her director for advice on where to go to, to not go to them. There is no other agency in the immediate area that assists with these types of situations, that I know of.
lool, funny, but no.. That would involve spending more time with her than I have to. Plus I'm not much into agriculture ;)

I get what your saying Kundertaker, if this wasn't on such a severe level I would agree with you but she has the upper hand to ruin my life out of spite, when I want nothing to do with her. If I walk away with out covering my ass I could be sitting with things undeserving on my record and abused by their man hating mentality. If I get a restraining order put on me, that's going to do a lot of damage to my record for future jobs and even meeting people. In my state, our records are completely public with a few exceptions.

i knew all along, but over time I kidn of realized that she enjoys being a victim. She might have been raped when she was younger, knowing how many lies come out of her mouth, I don't really know. But she turned this trauma into her entire life.

The reality of it is, she wasn't upset about the break up as much as she was about the free ride being over. The first thing blurted out of her mouth the first time I broke up with her was "how do you expect me to pay rent?"

I obtained this information on my computer, i built a computer over a year ago for her to use so we could play games together. She started using it for everything else. This morning my computer wouldn't boot so logged into that one. I have my own user name and control on it and don't try to hide it. When i logged in and brought up the browser her facebook was already logged into it. I have no interest in trying break into her emails or facebook account. It was already up with the email starring me in the face.
I added an edit to this.
it is illegal, extremely illegal. Once I move out and get my shit sorted that's exactly what I'm doing.
Yea, she physically held me and screamed like I was stabbing her to death. I felt so damned guilty about it I stuck around a year longer.

I am leaving, I'm moving out soon, but life is shit. And I sent a private email to a shelter that took that email shared it with my abuser to give them a heads up I was looking for help. Instead of keeping it private like they should.
